query: What different aspects of their purchase are Amazon reviewers actually talking about?

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Categorising the purchased item gives a strong, genuine axis to group what reviewers discuss across product types. Values are well grounded: toy doll, book, music, skin cream, and film are all correctly inferred from the source text. Some fine-grained sub-categories (e.g. exact retail category) require light inference but are sound readings.

per_column.name: functional_performance_verdict
per_column.rationale: Directly targets the 'does it work' aspect of purchases, a real analytical axis distinct from category. Sensible use of 'not_present' for reviews about media/content where functionality is irrelevant. Sample values (works_as_advertised for the cream; not_present for the doll-availability complaint) are well warranted by the text.

per_column.name: content_quality_dimension
per_column.rationale: Captures the media-content aspect (plot, acting, writing) that is a distinct discussion theme, complementary to functional verdict. Mostly grounded, though the Bicycle Thieves review is labelled 'narrative_plot' when the text focuses more on packaging/thematic value, and the Lamott book review (about political vs. faith writing) is 'narrative_plot' rather than writing_style — mild misreadings but defensible.

per_column.name: comparison_reference_type
per_column.rationale: Whether and how a reviewer benchmarks the item is a legitimate new axis. Grounding is mostly sound (Eamon review does invoke a genre/peer comparison; Bicycle Thieves compares to contemporary films). The 'compared_to_genre_standard' for Eamon is a slightly loose reading (self-comparison rather than genre standard), but overall reasonable.

judge.rationale: The four added columns each open a distinct, non-redundant axis (item type, functional verdict, content-quality facet, comparison behaviour) that directly serves the query about which aspects of a purchase reviewers discuss. None is near-constant or a mere restatement of another, and none reduces to a bare sentiment/length flag. Values are largely sound readings of the source text with appropriate 'not_present'/'no_comparison' handling for silent rows; only a few content-quality and comparison labels involve slightly loose inference, but no confident invented facts are observed.
